balls.text: Deccan finish well and Mishra has the last laugh, full toss and he smotes it over midwicket for a boundary to give this Deccan score some respectability

more drama, Mishra and Munaf collide, slower one bowled short outside off and it's cut fine, really fine, to the third-man boundary, Mishra, trying to get to the other end, ran into Munaf and there's a war of words yet again
eye contact this time from Mishra as he clips, beautifully, a full toss over square leg

four, on the bounce, short ball on leg stump, was that the slower one? Tried to pull it behind square, got a top edge and it just landed short of the ropes near fine leg. Munaf was in a war of words with Mishra and Dhawan, not sure who started it but lots of unpublishable words exchanged, I lost count
lands full outside off, dug out wide of cover for a single
not anymore, length ball and Dhawan connects it superbly, Munaf pitches it on middle and Dhawan dispatches it over the midwicket fence
in the blockhole outside off, digs it out wide of the bowler to pick a single
slower one, Mishra runs in and has a wild swing at that one, gets an inside edge onto his pads, just the single in the end
full ball outside off, drilled wide of Pollard at long-off for a couple of runs
gets across to that straighter delivery and clips it over square leg for a single
banged in short outside off, tried to pat it into the leg side, called a wide for height, Rayudu couldn't stop that, three more to the score
Dhawal does a Malinga. an excellent yorker on middle and Christian was done in for pace as much as the length, failed to get his bat down in time and middle stump was pegged back
short ball, slapped towards long-off for a single
flicks it through the leg side past square leg, rushes back for the second and makes it this time
slower one again, a swing and a miss this time
dropped, T Suman spills it at third man, slower one and Christian, having a mighty swing at that one, gets a top edge that Suman gets under but fails to latch on to, a simple one that
aiming for another yorker, squeezes it past cover for a single
superb yorker but missed leg stump, Dhawan failed to get his bat under that one, saved his legs but too bad for Mumbai that that wasn't on target
slower one bowled full outside off, driven uppishly into the deep, wide of deep point, for a brace
targeting middle and off now, drops it in front of cover and point for a quick single to keep strike
nicely done, quicker through the air from Harbhajan, low full toss outside off and Dhawan does well to get the shot right this time, reverse-paddle to the third-man boundary
round the wicket, swept straight to short fine leg, clinches a quick single
short of a good length on middle, turned past midwicket for a single
short of a length outside off, tries to reverse-paddle it past short third, fails to make contact
fullish around middle, swung towards midwicket for a single
in the blockhole outside off, digs it out wide of cover for a single and it's time for the time out
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, guided it wide of point for a single

four, in streaky fashion, a bit more pace on that one, dropped it short on middle, Dhawan tried to take his bottom hand off off that one while trying to dab it into the off side, got an inside edge past leg stump and to the fine-leg boundary
bowled full on middle, Dhawan can only manage to drive it back to the bowler
good length on leg stump, chips it in the direction of midwicket, gets to him on the bounce
slower one bowled on the pads, tickled behind square leg for a single
makes room and Dhawal follows him, gets it into the blockhole, Christian just manages to dig it out into the off side for one more
short of a good length on leg stump, turned away through square leg for  a single
a bit of width, drives it stylishly wide of deep cover for a couple of runs to get off the mark
pulled the slower one past square leg for a single

Slower one and it yields a wicket, a nicely disguised change of pace and Chipli had made up his mind to go for it, landed on a length and he tried to heave it over midwicket, miscued it to mid-on where T Suman judged it well
low full toss on the off, pushed hard but straight to mid-off
low full toss outside off, makes room and just about manages to reach it, pushed to extra cover, who's at the edge of the circle, for a single
slower one bowled short, pulled well but straight to deep midwicket, just the single
full toss on middle and leg, makes room and punches it down to long-on for a single
not coming on as well as he would like, short of a good length and he drags it down to long-on for a single
short and wide, goes for a cut but gets no bat on it
around a good length on middle, pushed off the front foot past midwicket for a single
knocked away into the off side for a single to keep strike

deceived by the slower one, Malinga, deceitful as ever, slips in a lovely slower one, lands on a length and Chipli tries to swing him over midwicket, miscues it towards Harbhajan at long-on, gets to him on the bounce
fullish delivery on the off, waits for it and dabs it in the direction of cover
drops it short outside off, Christian bunts it back past the bowler for a single
back of a length on the off, gets on the back foot and pushes it to point
steered wide of point to clinch a single
the slower legcutter, run down to third man for a single
slower one targeting middle and leg, driven wide of midwicket for a single
short of a good length, cutting in and Chipli handles it smartly, waits for it to come towards him and late-cuts it delicately to beat third man to the boundary, cheeky stuff
back of a length, gets back and pulls it down to long leg for one more
slower one bowled full, knocks it down behind point for a quick single
landing it on a length on middle, driven down the ground to long-on for a single
slightly short from round the wicket, drops it into the off side in front of point and sets off for a single
turns in with a bit of byte, gets on the back foot and drops it into the leg side

Harbhajan gets Duminy again! Duminy has been a bit of a bunny for him, especially with the tospinner that traps him in front. This, though, is a slow, loopy, elusive offbreak, Duminy stretches forward for a forward-defensive, and his back leg slides out. The ball turns and beats him, and Rayudu disturbs the bails with Duminy's foot on the line. Beautiful bowling
short, not too wide, but Duminy leans back and makes room to cut this wide of sweeper-cover
comes forward, covers the line of the offbreak, opens the face, gets a single
offbreak around off, pushed to straight midwicket

that's gone, Slower ball bowled short outside off and Sohal went for it, tried to crack it over extra cover, a shot more out of desperation than anything, miscues it straight to point where Symonds takes a dolly
short of a good length, Sohal's trying to get a move on here, something he should have managed a while back, makes room and taps it straight to Tendulkar at extra cover
back of a length outside off, backs away and tries to cut it hard over point, misses
short on the leg side, works it behind square for a single
charges down the track to that length delivery, tries to smack it over extra cover, just the single
banged in short, Duminy gets away from it
low full toss on the off, driven down to long-on for a single
shortish on middle, gets back and turns it for a single
angling in towards middle, clipped past square leg
short ball on the off, turning in, pulled away towards deep midwicket for a single
Sohal goes downtown, in the slot, was tossed up, landed in the right space on the off and he freed his arms to smack it over long-off for a big one
back of a length outside off, guided down towards third man for a single. Uncharacteristic innings from Sohal here
good length on the off stump, pushed into the deep off the front foot for a single
short of a good length on the off, nipped back in, or cut back in rather, fends it away into the leg side for a single
slower one bowled short, slaps it straight to cover, it's all over

full toss and Harbhajan, looking to swing it square, mistimed it to deep midwicket, they just managed a single, Malinga jogged the first one and was stunned to see Harbhajan calling for the second, it's an easy run-out at the non-striker's end, the game's been decided
slower ball down the leg side, falters to bowl a wide, two sixes needed now

Rajan's done it, pitched up outside off and Pollard senses another chance, was targeting the long-off boundary but he can't get his team across the line, gets a thick outside edge and Lumb takes it well at third man, Rajan's done it
Rajan's struggling, pitched up on the pads and Pollard flicks it away disdainfully over square leg for a boundary
full and wide, Pollard makes it thanks to the dive, slices it wide of Sohal at third man, he wanted the two the moment he hit it, ran back and dived full length to make it in time
down the leg side, can he retain his calm, concedes a wide
Smashed! Length ball and you don't want to bowl those to Pollard, in the slot and he dismisses him over deep midwicket, lands in the second tier
Pollard refuses the single, short ball on middle and Harbhajan was eyeing the square-leg boundary again, got hit on the ribs and wanted a leg bye but Pollard wants to face the last over
or have I said that a little too early, low full toss and Harbhajan swings it hard over square leg for a flat six
low full toss down the leg side and he helps it down to the fine-leg boundary, too little too late one would think
lovely stuff from Ishant, aiming for the yorker, almost gets it right, Pollard can only drive it to long-off for a single, Pollard wants two, Harbhajan doesn't want it, wasn't there
gets four though was fortunate, short and he went for the pull, got a top edge and just managed to get it wide of the long-leg fielder, squeezed four
short ball on middle and leg, turned away towards fine leg for a single

Pollard finds the gap, pitched up outside off and he lofts it over extra cover to beat the two fielders, long-off and deep cover, for a boundary, much-needed blow but still a long way to go for the hosts
tossed up outside off, swats it wide of long-off, just the single
punched past midwicket for a couple of runs, not enough
short and it turns away sharply, can't get his bat to it as he tries to tap it towards point, Deccan are running away with it here
fires it quick outside off, can only drive it past extra cover for a single
ooh, the googly almost bowled him, went for the slog-sweep but didn't pick the wrong'un, it went over the stumps
appeals for lbw but that pitched outside leg, Harbhajan went for the sweep and was struck on the pads but you cant give those
charges down the track and mistimes it wide of midwicket for a couple of runs, Ojha doing a splendid job
defended by Harbhajan, tossed up on the off, bends low and pushes it to extra cover
punches it past the bowler for a single
nice turn again, surprising Pollard, zips away and beats Pollard
turning away from a good length, Pollard rocks back and plays it to point

Tendulkar's been given out lbw, Mumbai has gone silent, straight ball and Tendulkar shuffled across to whip that fine, missed and was struck in line with midlde and leg, and height was no problem either
slower one again, Pollard drives that on the up wide of long-off ofr a single
Tendulkar swivels to whip that one fine but is struck on the hips, steals a leg bye
found long-on, slower one bowled short and Suman, for a moment, seemed to connect it well but he sliced it more than hitting it off the meat, Dhawan was positioned perfectly to clasp that one
back of a length on middle and leg, dabs it behind point for a quick single
short outside off, Tendulkar finds the gap, cracks it hard through point, third man is a little wide and can't get to it
finally gets one off the meat, short ball and it's a long hop begging to be hit, rocks back and pulls it hard over deep midwicket, he'll be a touch relieved there after consuming a few dots
what a lovely over, turn again and it's slower through the air once more, Suman makes room but it's not enough, ends up chopping it to short third
slower through the air, makes room and chops it in front of point, no single still
fires it short outside off and this doesn't turn, makes room to cut but can't connect, the pressure builds
turning away, short ball, Suman tries to smash it over extra cover, misses
missed run-out, tries to work it into the leg side, clips his pads, tries to steal a single and Sanga gathers, aims at the non-striker's end and misses not by much
flatter and slightly quicker through the air, chipped towards long-on for a single

appeal for a stumping, Tendulkar swept hard at that one but missed a straight one, Sanga collected and took off the bails, Tendulkar's got a part of his foot back inside the crease much to the relief of the Mumbai crowd but his team's on the back foot here
a bit of bounce there for Mishra that surprised Sachin a hint, drops it in front of point
pitched up outside off, makes room and drives it hard and uppishly past a diving extra cover, two more
tries to make room and play it through cover, gets a thick outside edge to short third man
floats it on a good length on middle, plays it back firmly to Mishra
pitched up outside off, driven hard towards extra cover
Christian slips in a wide down the leg side, the slower one but misdirected
in the slot and Suman sends it into the stands, picked the slower one, got under it and launched it over long-on, nice clean strike, Mumbai need to push on and Suman's doing that
slower one bowled slightly short on the off, cuts in, gets back and pushes it back to the bowler
length ball outside off, cracked towards deep cover for a single
short ball on the off, stands tall and slaps it towards mid-off where a misfield earns him a single
goodish length on the off, gets on the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler
short ball on the off, gets back and punches it to long-off for a single
the googly and Suman is struck on the pads but outside the line as hje tries to defend
gets on the back foot and punches it past midwicket for a single
chopped it in front of point

Symonds holes out, the pressure was building and Mishra got his man, slipped it in quicker, Symonds came down the track and tried to loft it over long-off as it turned, didn't get hold of it and Ishant took a comfortable catch, Mumbai are in trouble now
flighted on middle, driven towards long-off for a single
short ball outside off, run down wide of third man for a single
short of a good length, guides it down to third man for a single
good length on the off, pushed towards mid-off, no single there
slower ball bowled short on the off, mistimes it this time, gets a thick inside edge to midwicket
slower ball and Symonds was out of his crease, trying to smash it over cover, didn't pick the change in pace and missed
short ball on middle, gets on the back foot and knocks it down in front of square leg for a quick single
slides it down the leg side, called a wide
slightly short, taps it in front of cover for a single

that missed everything, short and it turned away big time, Tendulkar decided to play the pull but withdrew when it turned away as sharply as it did, Sangakkara was clueless about it as it slipped in between slip and keeper, four byes and Mishra isn't happy
another googly, Tendulkar gets on the back foot and defends it into the off side
the googly, short on middle, pulls it past square leg for a single
sightly short on the off, gets across and turns it wide of midwicket, rushes off for a single, Sohal picks up, takes aim and misses, Tendulkar would have been out had that hit
bowled flat and short on middle, punched to long-on for a single
bowls it short outside off, runs it down to third man for a single and it's time for a timeout
bowled on a good length on the off, plays it back to the bowler
another one but this one won't go down all the way, clips the pads on the way to Ishant at fine leg
a release and a short ball on leg stump provides that, Tendulkar spotted the length early and went across, tickling it down to the fine-leg boundary
short of a good length on middle, plays it softly in front of midwicket for a single
bowls it short outside off, chopped past point for a single
drops it short on the off, knocks it wide of the keeper to steal an easy single
short of a length and Tendulkar tries to flay that through point, it nips away to beat the outside edge
back of a length on the off, gets back and drops it in front of cover, thinks of the single but it isn't there
another wide down the leg side, shorter this time
sliding down the leg side and Tendulkar lets it be, called a wide
slower one bowled short outside off, crunched towards deep cover for a single
short ball on middle, Symonds tries to jab it in the direction of midwicket but ends up playing it just past the bowler
medium pace, good length on middle, turned past square leg for a single
flighted on the off, gets forward and opens the face to place it wide of point for a single

Symonds plays for the turn when it doesn't turn, Ojha targets middle and off, Symonds gets a stride out but is struck on the pads, seemed like he was struck in line but was height the problem? Replays say no, appeal for lbw turned down, would have clipped the bails to it's marginal
flights it full on middle, driven straight to midwicket
looping it on the off stump, Symonds gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover
flat just outside off, defends it towards cover
banged it short outside off, good bouncer, Tendulkar sways out of the way
lands on a god length, gets forward and pushes it towards cover
good length on the off, gets on the back foot and drops it towards cover

Ishant strikes again, a hint of away movement was all he needed to dismantle Rohit, pitched on a length and Rohit tried to drive it through the line just as it moved away, got a thin edge straight to Sanga, Deccan have the edge
fires it full on middle, flicked away to fine leg for a single
back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover point

Sanga appeals for a catch first, then the stumping, lovely delivery from Ojha as it angled in and then zipped away, caught-behind was turned down and replays show Rohit was in when Sanga took off the bails
width and he cashes in, full and flat and he creams it, slicing it hard past point for a boundary
floating it on middle and off, gets a big stride out and defends it towards cover
good length on the off, pushed towards extra cover
short of a good length outside off, just a hint of turn away from the batsman, lets it go
tossed up on middle, turns it past midwicket for a single

Ishant silences the Mumbai crowd that was just bracing up for a Mexican wave, Rayudu walked across a long way, good length on middle and leg and he tried to clip fine, missed and lost his leg stump. Tendulkar, at the non-striker's end, isn't happy, lets out a scream as he sees his partner make a mess of it
good length delivery on the off and he opts to play it off the back foot, defends it to the bowler
rises up to Rayudu there, nips back in from outside off, fends it into the leg side after taking his bottom hand off
short of a good length on middle, gets on the back foot and turns it into the leg side for a single
edged and four, there is a wide slip in place, it's short of a good length and Tendulkar chases it, targeting point, gets a thick outside edge to beat third man
short and quick but down the leg side, called a wide
played on the up, short of a good length on the off, opens the face and guides it wide a diving point, Mishra gets a hand to it but can't quite stop it, two more
tossed up on middle, comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler
turning in, flatter through the air, gets on the back foot and defends him down the pitch
low full toss on the off, pushed straight to cover
flighted, pitched up outside off, driven well wide of a diving extra cover for a couple of runs, Lumb got a hand to that one
turns in from a good length on middle, closes the face and plays it to short fine leg

bowled'im! Duminy's looked good, this one was angled in towards leg stump on length and Blizzard tried to swing that over midwicket, it turned away as he went for it, he missed and it crashed into off stump
lands full outside off, drags it towards mid-on, there's a fumble by Sohal there but no damage done, a single it stays
short of a good length on middle, rocks back and defends him towards mid-off
good length and he chases it, tries to smack him through the covers but doesn't make contact
back of a length outside off, run down to third man for a single
misfield at point, short of a good length, crunched from the crease towards Dhawan who let it through his legs for a couple
targets a good length on middle and off, Tendulkar gets back and pushes it back gently to the bowler
bowled flat on middle, pushed it back to the bowler, nice start by JP
floated full on middle, driven back to the bowler

ooh, beaten all ends up, lovely delivery, angling in from round the wicket, landed on middle and turned away sharply as Blizzard tried to close the face, missed everything, beating slip as well, on its way to the third-man boundary, four byes
bowled full outside off, squeezed wide of cover for a single
leading edge this time, gets across to turn it into the leg side but it holds its line, lands in front of point
meaty shot from Tendulkar, tossed up and bowled full outside of, drilled hard but straight to extra cover
